statement.text:
Let G be an infinite group admitting non-discrete Hausdorff group topologies,
and L (G) the lattice of all group topologies on G.
     a) Is it true that for any natural number k there exists a non-refinable chain
τ0 < τ1 < · · · < τk of length k of Hausdorff topologies in L (G)? (For countable
nilpotent groups this is true (A. G. Topale, Deposited in VINITI, 25.12.98, no. 3849–
V 98 (Russian)).)
  ∗ b) Let k, m, n be natural numbers and let G be a nilpotent group of class k.
Suppose that τ0 < τ1 < · · · < τm and τ0′ < τ1′ < · · · < τn′ are non-refinable chains of
Hausdorff topologies in L (G) such that τ0 = τ0′ and τm = τn′ . Is it true that m ⩽ n · k
and this inequality is best-possible? (This is true if k = 1, since for G abelian the
lattice L (G) is modular.)
     c) Is it true that there exists a countable G such that in the lattice L (G) there
are a finite non-refinable chain τ0 < τ1 < · · · < τk of Hausdorff topologies and an
infinite chain {τγ′ | γ ∈ Γ} of topologies such that τ0 < τγ′ < τk for any γ ∈ Γ?
  ∗ d) Let G be an abelian group, k a natural number. Let A be the set of all
                                                                      k
those Hausdorff group topologies on G that, for every topology τ ∈ Ak , any non-
refinable chain of topologies starting  from τ and terminating at the discrete topology
has length k. Is it true that Ak {τγ′ | γ ∈ Γ} =
                                  T
                                                 ̸ ∅ for any infinite non-refinable chain
{τγ′ | γ ∈ Γ} of Hausdorff topologies containing the discrete topology? (This is true
for k = 1.)                                                                V. I. Arnautov
  ∗ b) The inequality does hold, but it is not sharp (V. I. Arnautov, Bull. Acad. Ştiinţe
Repub. Moldova, Mat., 2010, no. 2 (2010), 3–19).
  ∗ d) No; moreover, no infinite abelian group satisfies this property with k = 2
(D. Peng, Preprint, 2023, https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08269).
